thesis: No new-entry capacity route, so new entrants rely on day-ahead revenue while the capacity framework is unsettled, and every ungranted design loses value at the platform's yields. Two cohorts are separate investments: a project in the 2025 grant cohort is the exception and carries its own call, and an asset holding an earlier seventeen-year contract is worth pricing only below replacement cost.
没有新进入的容量路径，因此在容量机制尚未确定时，新进入者依靠日前市场收入，所有无补贴设计按本平台收益率均损失价值。两个批次属于不同投资：2025年补贴批次中的项目是例外，并有其独立结论；持有早期十七年合同的资产，只值得以低于重置成本的价格定价。

reason: Seventh of fifteen markets on the design grid's hold IRR, 7.4% (23 October 2026).
按设计表测算的持有期IRR为7.4%（2026年10月23日），在十五个市场中排第七。
